definitions.gloss: the Major Leagues; Major League Baseball
definitions.explanation: The top professional baseball league in the United States. Used in Japanese to refer to MLB, especially in the context of Japanese players competing there.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大|だい}リーグ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}している→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: He is active in the Major Leagues.

examples.japanese: {大|だい}リーグ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}する→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧{日本人選手|にほんじんせんしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of Japanese players taking on the Major Leagues is increasing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{大|だい}リーグ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧だった。
examples.english: Since childhood, my dream was to become a Major League player.

notes:
USAGE:
A Japanese coinage combining {大|だい} (big, major) with ⟦リーグ→リーグ：11600_riigu⟧ (league). More colloquial and traditional than the loanword ⟦メジャー→メジャー：11595_mejaa⟧⟦リーグ→リーグ：11600_riigu⟧, which is also widely used. {大|だい}リーグ has a nostalgic feel, associated with classic baseball manga and older media coverage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|だい}リーグ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}する→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧ (to take on the Major Leagues)
- {大|だい}リーグ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}する→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧ (to be active in the Major Leagues)
- {大|だい}リーガー (Major Leaguer)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦メジャー→メジャー：11595_mejaa⟧⟦リーグ→リーグ：11600_riigu⟧: Major League — the loanword form, more common in current sports journalism
